decision.explanation: The question asks for the population of Croydon Park. The provided sources contain three distinct census records for this location: D1S7/D3S1 confirm 11,012 (2016 census), D2S5 confirms 10,929 (2021 census), and D4S2/D5S1 confirm 3,998 (2011 Census). These represent valid, distinct temporal data points rather than contradictions requiring elimination. All three values are explicitly supported by the source text and original cards.
